All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AgentCFR
Deep CFR trained for 1v1 poker games (Heads-up)
AllInCommand
Class that represents the All-in command, which is a type of Command that a player can execute during a hand of poker.
Bot
Abstract class that represents an automated poker player (bot).
BotFSM
Parent class for all finite state machine (FSM) based bots in the poker game.
BotLLM
Abstract class that represents a poker bot powered by a Large Language Model (LLM).
BotLLMOnline
Abstract class that represents an online LLM-based poker bot.
BotManager
The BotManager class is responsible for managing the registration and creation of different types of bots in the poker game.
BotNN
Abstract class that represents a poker bot powered by a Neural Network (NN).
CallCommand
Class that represents the Call command, which is used when a player wants to call the current bet.
CheckCommand
Class that represents the Check command in the game.
ClassifierFSM
This class represents a bot that uses a finite state machine (FSM) to decide its next move in a poker game.
ClientThread
Class that represents a connected player during the pre-game phase
Command
Abstract class that represents a command in the poker game.
CommandResult
Represents the result of a player's action during a betting round.
Controller
Class that represents the Controller of the poker game.
EquityCalculator
Utility class responsible for estimating the equity (win probability) of players in a Texas Hold'em hand.
Evaluator
Utility class responsible for evaluating poker hands.
Evaluator.RANK
Enumeration representing the different ranks of poker hands.
EvaluatorException
Exception thrown when an error occurs during the evaluation of a poker hand.
FoldCommand
Class that represents the fold command in the poker game.
Game
Represents a poker game instance with all necessary components and logic.
GameException
Base exception class for errors that occur during the game execution.
GeminiLLM
Concrete implementation of a poker bot powered by Google's Gemini LLM.
HandInfo
Represents the information associated with a player's hand.
HumanPlayer
Represents a human player in the poker game, responsible for handling communication with the player's client via a socket connection.
IPlayerActions
Interface representing the actions that a player can perform in a poker game.
IPlayerInfo
Interface to ONLY access player state(e.g: Name, On bet money, Off bet money, Player role, etc...)
IPlayerNotificator
Core interface for notifying players about game events and requesting their actions during a poker game.
LlamaPokerLLM
Concrete implementation of a poker bot powered by the Llama3 LLM.
Node
Represents a node in a doubly linked list of players in the game.
Player
Abstract class that represents a player in the poker game.
PlayerEvaluation
This record represents the evaluation of a player in a poker game, including their unique identifier and rank.
PlayerExperimentData
Stores the data collected for a player during a poker hand.
PlayerList
Represents a circular doubly linked list of players in the game, managing their states, actions, and interactions during the game.
PokerHistory
Writes PokerStars-style hand histories.
PotDistribution
Represents the distribution of the pot among players based on their contributions and ranks.
PotManager
The PotManager class is responsible for managing the pots in a poker game.

RaiseCommand
Class that represents the Raise command, which is a type of Command that a player can execute during a hand of poker.
ServerMain
Main class of the server.
ServerTCP
Class responsible for handling de pregame and game phases of the poker server.
Spectator
Represents a spectator in the poker game, allowing them to observe the game without participating as a player.
Timer
A simple timer implementation that counts down from a specified maximum value.
TurnTimeoutException
Exception thrown when a player's turn times out.
